name: headroom-spike
description: WP01 throwaway evaluation spike for headroom-mcp-compression-layer. Not shipped.
comment: The harness talks to the local Headroom PROXY over HTTP (lib/headroom-client.ts). Finding: the npm `headroom-ai` package is a thin proxy client (no in-process compression, no retrieve), so it is not a dependency here — the proxy ENGINE (Python headroom-ai 0.22.3) does the work and is the pinned version of record (C-001). Accuracy A/B runs via subagents -> runset/scored.json (see lib/accuracy.ts).
